results.evidence:
column cost (16x384x16), this machine, single-threaded:
  graph (compiled, extent 0 by construction):  0.994 ms/column
  multipass extent 0 (GDScript passes):         30.585 ms/column (30.8x graph)
  multipass extent 1 (+ neighbour cliff pass):  35.024 ms/column (35.2x graph)

RECOMMENDATION (M02+): keep the compiled graph as the default backend, with analytic
  extent-0 stamps for flora/structure density. Reserve the multipass evaluator for the
  few features that truly need cross-chunk reads (M08 trunks crossing chunk borders,
  M10 structures). Reasons, measured here:
  * multipass costs 30.8x the graph per column in pure GDScript, and that gap grows with
    every neighbour-aware pass added (extent 1 already adds 4.4 ms/column);
  * VoxelGeneratorMultipassCB is NOT scriptable in the 1.7 GDExtension
    (probe_multipass2.gd: 'Can't inherit from a virtual class', no passes property),
    so there is no engine-accelerated multipass path to move this into;
  * MultipassCB also has no LOD support, which the distant-terrain milestone (M13) needs.
  The graph path therefore stays default; 'multipass' remains selectable in config for
  the features above and for cross-checking (55/64 chunks match the graph on seed 20260814).
